thread:
lina-cs: Weekly ops check — p95/p99 by route/model + streaming vs non-streaming for the NOVA cohort. Short summary and actions? :mag_right:
sofia-sre: quick snapshot below, streaming tail is usually better but we've got a clear anomaly on /summarize non-stream. posting table.
sofia-sre: ```
route,model,mode,p95_ms,p99_ms,err_rate,req_count
/chat,redwood-medium,streaming,210,480,0.12%,12400
/chat,redwood-medium,non-stream,430,980,0.35%,4200
/summarize,redwood-large,streaming,320,700,0.50%,3800
/summarize,redwood-large,non-stream,680,1600,1.20%,1150
/embeddings,embed-small,streaming,90,150,0.05%,18900
/embeddings,embed-small,non-stream,120,260,0.08%,1020
```
henry-eng: Can you break down the /summarize errors? 1.2% at that volume is concerning.
sofia-sre: Most are `OUT_OF_MEMORY` from KV cache and some `deadline exceeded` timeouts when seq > 1024. Sample log snippet: ```
ERROR 2026-03-18T09:12:44Z route=/summarize model=redwood-large mode=non-stream err=OUT_OF_MEMORY seq=2048 instance=gpu-17
ERROR 2026-03-18T09:12:46Z route=/summarize model=redwood-large mode=non-stream err=deadline_exceeded latency_ms=1620
```
sam-csm: Noted — customer mentioned they kicked off an indexing run mid-week, could explain higher non-stream payloads. I'll confirm. :memo:
henry-eng: For triage, quick mitigation is to cap non-stream max_seq to 512 for redwood-large on that account; expect ~30% drop in p99 and reduce OOMs. I'll try in staging and report perf.
sofia-sre: I also added an alert: `p99>1000ms` for route=/summarize mode=non-stream account=nova. Turned on notify to #onboard-nova and ops on-call.
ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-332 and assigned to henry-eng. Priority=P2.
lina-cs: Action items: 1) henry to test sequence cap + memory tuning (ETA: Thu EOD). 2) sofia to keep alert and watch error spikes (ETA: ongoing). 3) sam to confirm if indexing job is intentional and pause if needed (ETA: tomorrow AM). 4) I'll draft a short customer note explaining expected impact and workaround.
henry-eng: Will run load test in staging with `max_seq=512` and report raw numbers (p95/p99 + error delta). If that looks good, we'll deploy a temporary config for the next 48h.
sam-csm: Confirmed — index job was a test, not production. I'll ask them to pause and will update here.
sofia-sre: small FYI on spend: account spend up ~18% last week driven mostly by embeddings calls (high req_count). Embedding p95/p99 fine, but volume is the driver.
lina-cs: Good catch. Sam, if they intended the indexing test, we should coordinate a scheduled window to avoid surprise bill.
sam-csm: Will do. I'll also offer a rate-limited plan for large indexing windows.
lina-cs: Any other blockers?
henry-eng: None from infra side. Will update with staging numbers.
sofia-sre: I'll keep the watch and escalate if p99 > 1.5s after mitigation.
ops-bot: Reminder: incident INC-2026-332 updated (status=investigating).
lina-cs: Thanks all — reconvene next Tue for a follow-up. Owners: henry-eng (triage), sofia-sre (alerts), sam-csm (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
